attributes.name: Master Cartman
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, when you acquire a boon, you may display it next to this card. While displayed, you may recharge this card to draw the boons displayed next to it, then you may give any of them to another character.

Discard this card to move, then explore your location.
